mostWorthwhile.text: Making and secreting collagen was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects gene activity and protein synthesis to extracellular support, while keeping the fibroblasts alive beside the matrix.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second amino-acid combination repeated the protein-synthesis pattern already established for collagen, although it reinforced the comparison between cell types.

surprise.text: The muscle goal ended at separate myoblasts rather than a fused fibre; that clarified the difference between muscle commitment and mature muscle.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The named differentiation conditions made the choices clear, though the particular signals and how they change gene activity were not explained.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the separate myoblasts develop into a muscle fibre, particularly because the final picture explicitly leaves that development unfinished.
